Planning estimate. Excludes income tax, appreciation, leasing fees, and capital projects not entered in your budgets.

Understand the assumptions.

Annual collected rent = scheduled rent × 12 × (1 − vacancy %). Management fee is modeled as a percentage of collected rent. Net operating income subtracts annual operating expenses and the modeled management fee. Cash flow also subtracts debt payments. Cap rate divides net operating income by purchase price; cash-on-cash return divides annual cash flow by cash invested.
